description: The spiral citadel of Cổ Loa was built near modern Hanoi.

description: The Han dynasty annexed the region beginning a millennium of rule.

description: The Trưng sisters led a rebellion against Han rule.

description: Han general Ma Yuan crushed the Trưng rebellion.

description: The warrior Lady Triệu led an uprising against Wu rule.

description: Ngô Quyền used wooden stakes in the river to trap enemy ships.

description: Trần Cảnh became emperor at age eight.

description: Kublai Khan's second invasion was defeated by the Trần army.

description: The decisive victory ended Mongol ambitions against Đại Việt.

description: Ming forces conquered Đại Việt ending the Hồ dynasty.

title: Lê Dynasty Founded

description: Conflict intensified between North and South Vietnam.

description: US aircraft began sustained bombing of the North.

description: Vietnam launched a mass vaccination campaign.
